summary.intent: Determine whether a high-severity 'slop blocker' finding on callisto trail 198 / change 51 (PR #442) is a real issue or should be dismissed.
summary.outcome: Verified the finding against the PR code and CI: it is real. The PR's explicit tag refspec breaks the test harness's tag recorder, and the Test Suite fails on ubuntu and macos. The low-severity second finding about test coverage is also valid. No changes were made; a fix was offered.

repo: callisto PR #442 (branch fix/tag-push-explicit-refspec) changes push_tag to send refs/tags/v1:refs/tags/v1 as the third git push argument, to avoid ambiguity when a branch shares the tag's name.
The test harness (release_harness.rs) fakes git and records pushed tags in a fake remote via record_pushed_tag, which assumes a bare tag name in $1/$3.
record_pushed_tag swallows failures with `|| return 0`, so a bad ref silently results in no tag being recorded and publish cannot observe it.
The module already has real-git test machinery that could be used for an end-to-end tag push test.
CI for callisto #442 fails on Test Suite (ubuntu and macos), Code Coverage and Entire Gates. The ubuntu log shows 3 failed, 269 passed, 1 skipped out of 272 run.

code.finding: Inline fake git calls `record_pushed_tag "$3"`; with the new refspec argument, `rev-parse refs/tags/$1` becomes refs/tags/refs/tags/v1:refs/tags/v1, fails, and the failure is swallowed.
RIG_GIT_TAIL also calls `record_pushed_tag "$3"` and has the same breakage. Both call sites need to strip the refspec to the bare tag name (e.g. strip the refs/tags/ prefix and cut at ':').

workflow: Verify a reviewer's finding against the actual PR code and CI results rather than trusting the finding's description.
Swallowed errors (`|| return 0`) in test helpers can turn a real break into a silent missing-state failure, which makes the root cause harder to spot from CI output.
Before editing someone's PR, propose the fix and ask first; the plan is to commit to the PR's own branch, run callisto's full gate, and wait for CI before calling it done.

friction: Could not extract the three failing test names from the ubuntu CI log; the only name that appeared was a PASS, so the failures were not matched to the finding by name.
The link to the trail/change did not directly give the PR number, so it had to be resolved to callisto #442.
open_items: Fix release_harness.rs so record_pushed_tag receives the bare tag name at both call sites (lines 541 and 1266), pending user approval.
Add a real-git test that creates branch v1 and tag v1, pushes to a bare remote, and checks the tag lands, since the current test only asserts the formatted string.
Confirm the three failing tests map to the harness break once the fix is pushed and CI re-runs.
Check that Code Coverage and Entire Gates go green after the fix.
